figures.shows: Raw dirty continuum images of the 12m-array mosaic, ACA mosaic and jointly imaged Band 3 observations of XLSSC 122, with r500,c circles and ACT-y contours overlaid on the joint image.
figures.validation_check: Shows that the ACT-y contours and the ALMA+ACA SZ decrement align spatially, a comparison with independent data.
readable_values: approx. RMS 0.051, 0.014, 0.022 mJy beam-1 for the three images
approx. colour scale limits ±0.08, ±0.20, ±0.10 mJy beam-1
figures.caption_quote: We clearly see that the ACT and ALMA+ACA observations align spatially.

figures.shows: Distribution of the number of visibilities versus uv-distance for ALMA and ACA Band 3 observations, with ACT beams at 150 and 100 GHz overlaid.
readable_values: approx. ALMA visibility peak near 30 kλ
approx. ACA visibility peak near 8 kλ
approx. ACT 100 GHz beam falls to near zero by about 3 kλ
figures.caption_quote: Distribution of the number of visibilities as a function of the uv-distance sampled with ALMA (yellow) and ACA (blue) Band-3 observations.

figures.shows: Multiwavelength view: dirty joint ALMA+ACA Band 3 map with member galaxies, XMM-Newton X-ray image with SZ decrement contours, and HST F140W image with X-ray and ACT contours and the CARMA SZ centroid.
figures.validation_check: Checks coherence between ICM pressure, X-ray density and the cluster member distribution.
readable_values: approx. SZ colour scale ±0.08 mJy beam-1
approx. X-ray counts range 1 to about 10 counts
figures.caption_quote: Overall, this figure indicates a coherence between the pressure and density distribution of the ICM seen by ALMA+ACA and X-ray measurements, and the cluster member distribution.

figures.shows: Spectra of two emission-line interlopers in a single beam: CO(2-1) at about 105.3 GHz in Band 3 (ALMA and ACA) and CO(4-3) near 155.9 GHz in Band 4 (ALMA), from galaxies at z=1.19 and z=1.96.
readable_values: approx. Band 3 CO(2-1) peak 1.0 mJy near 105.25 GHz
approx. Band 4 CO(4-3) peak 1.5 mJy near 155.9 GHz
figures.caption_quote: The line emission comes from two galaxies at z = 1.19 and z=1.96 which are also detected in optical broad- band images.

figures.shows: Most likely single elliptical gNFW model: dirty ALMA+ACA image, likelihood-weighted smoothed model, model corrected for uv-coverage, and residual map after subtracting the model from the visibilities.
figures.validation_check: Shows the model resembles the data and that residuals after model subtraction contain no obvious structure.
readable_values: approx. model minimum about -0.10 mJy/beam
approx. residual range ±0.08 mJy/beam
figures.caption_quote: The model shows a clear resemblance to the data.

figures.shows: Radial uv-distribution of real part and imaginary part of visibilities for ACA (left) and ALMA (right) with median empirical SZ models (A10 and M14 classes, ensemble average, cool cores, disturbed).
figures.validation_check: Compares empirical pressure-template models against the observed visibilities, disfavouring a local cool-core morphology.
readable_values: approx. ACA Re(V) at 1 kλ about -1.0 to -1.7 mJy across models
approx. ALMA Re(V) near 0 mJy beyond 10 kλ
figures.caption_quote: the data disfavors a local cool core cluster as the morphological state of XLSSC 122.

figures.shows: Derived radial pressure profiles of best-fit elliptical empirical models (A10 and M14 classes) with ensemble average, cool-core and disturbed templates.
readable_values: approx. P(10 kpc) about 0.3 keV cm-3 for the cool-core A10 model
approx. P(10 kpc) about 0.04 keV cm-3 for M14 models
figures.caption_quote: Derived radial pressure profiles of the best-fit elliptical models which follow the empirical formalism as shown in Table 1.

figures.shows: Same as Figure 6 but with ACT data included in the model fitting, showing real and imaginary visibilities for ACA and ALMA with model curves.
figures.validation_check: Tests how adding the ACT large-scale constraint changes the empirical model fits to the uv data.
readable_values: approx. ACA Re(V) at 1 kλ about -0.9 to -2.3 mJy across models
figures.caption_quote: We observe a tighter correlation at smaller uv-distances, an overall larger amplitude, and a smaller eccentricity.

figures.shows: Derived radial pressure profiles with ACT constraints included, for A10 and M14 classes with ensemble average, cool-core and disturbed templates.
readable_values: approx. P(10 kpc) about 0.3 keV cm-3 for the cool-core A10 model
approx. P(1000 kpc) about 3e-5 keV cm-3
figures.caption_quote: Same as Figure 7 but with the addition of ACT constraints, as in Figure 9.

figures.shows: Cleaned ACA+ALMA image combining the reconstructed single elliptical gNFW model with imaged residuals, showing the SZ decrement with cluster member positions and r500,c circle.
readable_values: approx. minimum surface brightness -0.20 mJy/Beam
approx. colour scale ±0.20 mJy/Beam
figures.caption_quote: We observe asymmetric features in the south, potentially indicating a morphological disturbance to the cluster.

figures.shows: Two-component model reconstructions (elliptical and spherical, with and without ACT) compared with the ALMA+ACA cleaned contours, after smoothing to 5 arcsec.
figures.validation_check: Compares elliptical versus spherical two-component models against the observed surface brightness distribution.
readable_values: approx. colour scale ±0.20 mJy/Beam
figures.caption_quote: This figure indicates that the two-elliptical SZ components better resembles the surface brightness distribution of XLSSC 122 than the spherical one.

figures.shows: Overview of halo masses M500,c from X-ray, SZ (CARMA, ACT catalogue, this work spherical/elliptical/empirical average) and dynamical modelling for XLSSC 122.
figures.validation_check: Compares halo masses across independent tracers, showing discrepancies between SZ, X-ray and dynamics.
readable_values: approx. X-ray (Chandra) mass log10 about 13.8 in black
approx. SZ mass (This work) log10 about 14.2
approx. dynamical modelling log10 about 14.7
figures.caption_quote: This figure shows the discrepancies between the derived M500,c indicating that with forming clusters, one cannot reliably use one tracer or constant gas fraction to estimate the true halo mass.

figures.shows: Multiwavelength composite of XLSSC 122 with HST F140W background, XMM-Newton X-ray contours, cluster members, cleaned SZ decrement in blue, and red contours of the two-gNFW ALMA+ACA+ACT model.
readable_values: approx. synthesized beam 5 arcsec shown bottom left
figures.caption_quote: The figure indicates a clear morphological difference between the equation of state parameters traced by X-ray and the SZ effect.

figures.shows: Pseudo-kBTe map (y/sqrt(SX)) of XLSSC 122, the ratio of the cleaned SZ map to X-ray surface brightness within 2 sigma adaptively smoothed X-ray contours, with member galaxies.
readable_values: approx. pseudo-temperature range about -1 to 6.5 x 10^-5 (arbitrary units)
figures.caption_quote: The units are linearly scaled to an arbitrary value to show the relative pseudo temperature change in the south of XLSSC 122.
